function.description: Answer any factual question about the business — hours, address, parking, contact, what we offer, policies, memberships, or our team. Call it even when you think you remember the answer; you don't. If it returns no approved answer, say the front desk will confirm and offer a callback or transfer — never improvise.
function.name: getBusinessInfo
